evidence.title: EuroLeague teams reject NBA offer to merge into a single Europe operation

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague shareholder clubs meeting records and Barcelona statement
occurrences.quote_span: EuroLeague basketball owners have rejected a formal offer from the NBA to merge into a single European operation following a meeting in Italy, Barcelona confirmed Wednesday.
occurrences.speaker: Barcelona
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Barcelona statement
occurrences.quote_span: “Among those decisions was the rejection of the NBA’s proposal as it currently stands.
occurrences.speaker: Barcelona
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Barcelona emailed response to The Associated Press
occurrences.quote_span: Barcelona told The Associated Press in an emailed response that a formal merger offer from the NBA had been rejected.
occurrences.speaker: Barcelona
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Associated Press records of its request for comment to the NBA
occurrences.quote_span: The NBA did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague response to the Associated Press
occurrences.quote_span: The EuroLeague declined to comment and pointed to its initial statement.
occurrences.speaker: EuroLeague
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague shareholder clubs meeting records
occurrences.quote_span: The decision not to accept the NBA’s proposal of a single Europe entity was made Tuesday in Cernobbio during a gathering of the EuroLeague’s 13 shareholder clubs.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Barcelona statement
occurrences.quote_span: In a statement, the club confirmed that Barcelona president Joan Laporta attended the meeting and that club owners “took several decisions regarding the future of the competition.”
occurrences.speaker: Barcelona
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague meeting records and franchise licensing documents
occurrences.quote_span: At Tuesday’s EuroLeague meeting, club owners agreed to move forward with converting the current 10-year licenses into franchises for the shareholder clubs.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague website statement
occurrences.quote_span: A statement on the EuroLeague’s website said they met to “discuss and align on key strategic decisions regarding the future of their collective property,” without mentioning the NBA.
occurrences.speaker: EuroLeague
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Barcelona statement
occurrences.quote_span: Should that proposal be amended in the future, the clubs and the EuroLeague will reconsider it,” the statement read.
occurrences.speaker: Barcelona
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague meeting records and franchise expansion plans
occurrences.quote_span: They also agreed to continue plans to increase the number of franchises.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

evidence.title: Euroleague shareholders reject NBA Europe offer, door open for future talks

occurrences.checkable_against: Euroleague shareholder meeting records and NBA-Euroleague negotiations
occurrences.quote_span: Sources familiar with the discussions told Reuters that the Euroleague's shareholder clubs rejected a collaboration offer from the NBA, though the door on a deal was not yet closed.
occurrences.speaker: sources familiar with the discussions
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Conference agenda and George Aivazoglou appearance records
occurrences.quote_span: NBA Europe's managing director, George Aivazoglou, is due to speak at a conference in London on Thursday.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA proposal documents and contemporaneous media reports
occurrences.quote_span: Reuters was not immediately able to confirm the details of the NBA's offer, but media reports said it envisaged the NBA's continental expansion project merging with the Euroleague.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters and media reports
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Euroleague statement and October 2, 2026 comments to Reuters
occurrences.quote_span: The Euroleague did not refer to the widely reported NBA offer in its statement but told Reuters last Friday it remained open to collaboration. Although the clubs rejected the current proposal, talks with the NBA could continue.
occurrences.speaker: Euroleague
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA-Euroleague competition launch plans
occurrences.quote_span: A senior sports executive told Reuters any collaboration was unlikely to begin before 2028 because it would be difficult to organise a new competition in time for the 2027-28 season.
occurrences.speaker: a senior sports executive
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA European streaming agreements and audience records
occurrences.quote_span: Streaming deals with providers like Amazon Prime have boosted audiences for the NBA in Europe, while regular-season games in Berlin and London this year highlighted the league's growing appeal.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA and Euroleague public statements on a new competition
occurrences.quote_span: The NBA and Euroleague have said throughout this year they want to collaborate on a new competition, but both have also made clear they are prepared to pursue their own plans if no agreement is reached.
occurrences.speaker: NBA and Euroleague
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA and Euroleague communications on a revised collaboration proposal
occurrences.quote_span: The Euroleague is eager to press ahead with expansion, the source said, turning attention to whether the NBA will submit a revised proposal before those decisions are made.
occurrences.speaker: the source
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Euroleague shareholder meeting attendance records
occurrences.quote_span: Representatives of the 13 permanent shareholder clubs met near Lake Como, with the NBA proposal dominating discussions about the future of European basketball.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Euroleague statement on October 6, 2026 shareholder decisions
occurrences.quote_span: In separate decisions at the meeting, the clubs agreed to convert into franchises but stopped short of formally approving an expansion of the competition from 20 to 24 teams, the Euroleague said in a statement.
occurrences.speaker: Euroleague
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: FIBA statement or media response
occurrences.quote_span: FIBA, basketball's global governing body, said it would not comment at this stage.
occurrences.speaker: FIBA
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Euroleague decisions on additional long-term licences
occurrences.quote_span: A person attending the meeting told Reuters the decision on allocating additional long-term licences would be taken within the next month.
occurrences.speaker: a person attending the meeting
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Euroleague franchise agreements and existing long-term licence contracts
occurrences.quote_span: The move to a franchise model will give the clubs a more permanent stake in the competition than their existing long-term licences.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Euroleague licence-allocation rules and decisions
occurrences.quote_span: Up to eight could be awarded and the remaining places would be filled through a combination of short-term licences, wildcards and sporting qualification through the BKT EuroCup.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: Reuters request-for-comment records and NBA statement
occurrences.quote_span: The NBA did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

evidence.title: NBA Europe plans continue after EuroLeague rejects merger

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA-EuroLeague negotiation records or public statements
occurrences.quote_span: Despite that, talks are expected to continue as the NBA works toward a collaborative approach with EuroLeague.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague membership vote and merger-offer records
occurrences.quote_span: Membership groups from EuroLeague, which has been operating in the region since 1958, rejected a merger offer from the NBA that would have lumped operations under the proposed NBA Europe umbrella, a person with direct knowledge of the matter confirmed to USA TODAY Sports.
occurrences.speaker: person with direct knowledge of the matter
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague shareholder vote records
occurrences.quote_span: In any case, the measure was put to a vote that did not pass.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Euroleague shareholder clubs
